title: ModelUsage
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool -m <model> model usage` (CLI-SPEC §6) — the model-wide usage/audit read. `usage` maps EVERY field path to the full names of the rules and computations whose condition directly references it (an empty array = referenced by nothing); `unreferenced` is the subset of fields with no referrer. Built on the same `getDirectlyReferencedEntities` primitive as `where-used`, so the two can never disagree about what 'references' means. Fields are in model order; referrers are sorted.

usage.description: field path → the rule/computation full names that directly reference it (empty array = nothing reads the field)

items.description: a referencing rule's or computation's full name

unreferenced.description: the fields no rule or computation reads — the audit headline (candidates for removal, or a missing rule)
